segmentation.text: may be equipped with a siren, whistle or bell, capable of emitting sound audible under normal conditions from a distance of not less than 500 feet,
but the siren must not be used
except when the vehicle is operated in response to an emergency call
or in the immediate pursuit of an actual or suspected violator of the law,
in which event the driver of the vehicle may sound the siren to warn pedestrians and other drivers of his or her approach.
A driver of an emergency vehicle may operate the vehicle’s warning lamps without sounding the siren.

elements.justification: 'authorized emergency vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle ('a vehicle permitted to depart from certain traffic laws when equipped and operated in the manner provided by law'), claimed as the aggregate and never replaced by ru.emergency_vehicle.

sig.siren: 'a siren, whistle or bell sounding (audible; a source without audio declares it absent, and does not read a warning lamp as the sound)'. 'the siren must not be used' is the subject's own sig.siren not sounding. The exclusion of the warning lamp is respected: the lamp enters only the exception.

Responding to an emergency call is a purpose; ru.emergency_vehicle's contract says 'the class alone is not responding; its responding is conduct'. The conduct of a vehicle operated in response to a call is the display of its warning lamps: sig.warning_lamp, 'a warning lamp lit; colour in {red, blue, amber, white}, mode in {flashing, rotating, steady}', read with mode flashing or rotating. Its exclusion 'Not a stand-in for: an audible warning' is respected: the lamp is never read as the siren.

Immediate pursuit of a violator is a purpose read through the same conduct: the pursuing vehicle displays its warning lamps, sig.warning_lamp 'a warning lamp lit', mode flashing or rotating; not read as an audible warning.

residues.why: A permission about equipment and its audible range; it imposes no duty on conduct and the rule judges only whether the siren sounds.

Restates the permission the exception (s4, s5) grants: in that event the siren may sound. The purpose 'to warn pedestrians and other drivers of his or her approach' is what a sounding siren does; the duty is the same whether or not these words are read.
A permission to show warning lamps without the siren; it imposes no duty, and the siren duty never judges lamps alone.

applicability: The subject is an authorized emergency vehicle (DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle), except at an observation at which it displays a warning lamp (sig.warning_lamp) in mode flashing or rotating, which is read as the vehicle operated in response to an emergency call or in immediate pursuit (s4, s5).
obligation: At every such observation the subject's sig.siren is not sounding.

narrowings.why: Operation in response to an emergency call is read through its conduct, the vehicle's warning lamps flashing or rotating; a response made without lamps is not recognised.
Immediate pursuit of an actual or suspected violator is read through the pursuing vehicle's warning lamps flashing or rotating; a pursuit without lamps is not recognised.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A police car (authorized emergency vehicle) drives with sig.siren sounding and no sig.warning_lamp lit.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The police car drives with sig.siren silent and no warning lamp lit.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject is a private passenger car, not an authorized emergency vehicle; its siren is not observed to sound.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The police car drives with no warning lamp lit; the source has no audio, sig.siren absent.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The police car drives with red and blue sig.warning_lamp flashing and sig.siren sounding: operated in response to a call.
